subject: Supplier bulk identity enrollment for PO portal — onboarding checklist and remittance mapping
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acme-ops.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Bulk supplier enrollment for PO portal — scope and template request

Hi Rafael,

We're getting ready to onboard our supplier base (approx. 1,200 active payees) into Redwood's PO portal. Instead of adding records one-by-one, we'd like to do a bulk upload. Can you send the CSV template and a brief checklist of the fields you require for a smooth AP match (e.g., legal name, TIN, remit account, invoice contact, PO mapping fields)?

A few items on our side we want to confirm up front: currency handling for international suppliers, whether Redwood needs W-9/W-8 for US/non-US entities, and how you handle suppliers with multiple remit accounts. We want to avoid payment rejections in the first cycle.

Can we target a pilot with a subset of 50 suppliers next week? Also please flag any required SLA changes or testing windows we should know about.

Thanks,
Sophie Grant
Sr. AP Manager | Acme Logistics
accounts-payable@acme-ops.com

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acme-ops.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bulk supplier enrollment for PO portal — scope and template request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear note. We're set up to support bulk enrolls and can meet the pilot next week. I've attached our enrollment_template.csv and PO_format_spec.pdf which outline the mandatory and optional fields. Quick highlights:

- Mandatory fields: legal_name, tax_id (TIN/VAT), remit_currency, remit_bank_name, remit_iban_or_account, remit_routing, primary_invoice_email, PO_reference_field (po_number).
- Optional but recommended: DBA name, secondary_remit_account, tax_withholding_flag, invoice_sample_url.
- PO matching: your PO number must appear in the invoice body and in the EDI/po_reference field in the CSV for automatic matching. If the PO is missing we will route to manual queue and that delays payment.

Action items for pilot:
- You upload 50 supplier rows into the attached CSV and return to us.
- We'll run an enrollment pass in a staging portal and create test PO + invoice cycle for 5 suppliers.
- Finance will validate remittance mapping and run a $1 test where ACH is available.

Timeline: If you send the CSV by Friday (10/2), we can kick off the staging run on Monday (10/5) and provide results by Wednesday (10/7).

I've looped Kim (Finance lead) and Marcus (Integration) to confirm bank/payment rails and edge cases (multi-remit accounts, partial invoices).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

[Attachments: enrollment_template.csv, PO_format_spec.pdf]

From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acme-ops.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bulk supplier enrollment for PO portal — scope and template request

Thanks Rafael — received the templates. A couple quick clarifications before we populate the 50-supplier pilot: 

1) Currency: most suppliers are USD but ~8% are EUR/GBP. Will the single CSV accept per-supplier currency and will Redwood route SEPA/ACH/SWIFT automatically based on the remit fields?
2) Tax forms: For US vendors we will provide W-9s; for EU vendors we will provide VAT registration numbers. Is Redwood expecting formal W-8/W-9 copies during enrollment or can those be provided upon payment initiation?
3) Multi-remit: a handful of suppliers have both domestic and international remit accounts — do you accept multiple remit rows per supplier or do we create separate supplier IDs?

I've attached a small sample file (sample_suppliers.csv) with five rows — two have EUR remit accounts to test routing.

Also, do you have a DocuSign or onboarding consent we should sign for bulk identity sync?

Sophie

[Attachment: sample_suppliers.csv]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acme-ops.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bulk supplier enrollment — tax & payment rails (details)

Hi Sophie — Kim from Finance here. Quick answers: 

- Currency & routing: Yes — the enrollment CSV accepts a per-row currency code. If remit_bank and IBAN/SWIFT are present we will route to the proper payment rail (ACH for USD domestic, SEPA for EUR, BACS/GBP when applicable, SWIFT for others). Please include the currency column (remit_currency) and confirm the account is enabled for cross-border settlement.

- Tax docs: For US suppliers we require a W-9 on file prior to setting a remit account as "active". For non-US suppliers, provide VAT/GST registration numbers; if the supplier is not VAT-registered we need a declaration (simple form) to support tax handling. We can mark records as "provisionally enrolled" if docs are pending but payments will be blocked until documents are uploaded.

- Multi-remit accounts: The CSV supports multiple remit rows per supplier (use supplier_id + remit_index columns). We prefer a single supplier_id with separate remit entries; our upload will normalize into a single supplier record with two remit destinations.

A few additional operational constraints:
- PO rules: PO number must be present and not exceed 30 characters. PO date must be in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) to align with our matching engine.
- Cutoffs: ACH runs close of business (5:00 PT) two business days before settlement date — please account for lead times.
- Partial payments: allowed only if the invoice line-level allocation is supplied; otherwise payments will adhere to full-invoice settlement.

I've attached a sample_remit_mapping.xlsx with examples and the headers our ingestion expects. If you confirm the pilot set and upload by Friday, we'll schedule the staging run as Rafael outlined.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

[Attachment: sample_remit_mapping.xlsx]

- I'll upload 50 pilot suppliers (CSV) Friday EOD (10/02).
- We'll include W-9s for US suppliers and VAT numbers where applicable. For vendors missing docs we'll flag them in the CSV so they are provisionally enrolled and excluded from payment until docs are uploaded.
- Pilot target: Redwood to run staging enroll + 5 test PO/invoice cycles the week of 10/05. We'll aim for a $1 test ACH where possible and full cycle validation for the EUR suppliers.

Attached is our signed onboarding consent for the bulk sync (onboarding_consent_signed.pdf). DocuSign copy: https://app.docusign.com/some/consent/ACME-4552. HubSpot ticket: HS-ACME-5521.

If you want me to break out supplier groups (e.g., EUR remits first), let me know — otherwise we'll upload mixed currency and rely on your routing.
